pkgmetadata.longdescription: Handy is a free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline, using local whisper.cpp and ONNX-based models to transcribe speech triggered by a global hotkey. Captures global hotkeys and injects text via /dev/uinput, so the running user must belong to the "input" group.

use.flag: Link against the prebuilt sci-libs/onnxruntime-bin instead of building against sci-libs/onnxruntime compiled from source
